in_framework_policy_comparison.statement: All policies execute on the same verified DitServe native runtime, worker pool, SP/CFG collective transport, and calibrated latency profile to isolate scheduling mechanisms (optimal Static-<Form>, TetriServe-policy, SBP-ESP, EDF-BF vs. DitServe) on the Wan + SD3.5 mixed-workload main table; the in-house heuristics EDF-CFG2 and CFG2-First run only in the ablation suite.
in_framework_policy_comparison.best_static_form_rule: select best calibrated Static-<Form> (default static-cfg2sp4 on 8xA100)

tetriserve.role: external native runtime validation on supported image intersection

xdit.native_intersection_scope: single-model fixed partition/SP scaling (Wan2.1, Wan2.2, SD3.5)
xdit.role: external native engine validation under fixed partition / static SP (unoptimized single-GPU per request, xdit-sp1)

baseline_comparison_contract.statement: All policies execute on the same verified DitServe native runtime, worker pool, SP/CFG collective transport, and calibrated latency profile to isolate scheduling mechanisms (optimal Static-<Form>, TetriServe-policy, SBP-ESP, EDF-BF vs. DitServe) on the Wan + SD3.5 mixed-workload main table; the in-house heuristics EDF-CFG2 and CFG2-First run only in the ablation suite.
baseline_comparison_contract.best_static_form_rule: select best calibrated Static-<Form> (default static-cfg2sp4 on 8xA100)

tetriserve.role: external native runtime validation on supported image intersection

xdit.native_intersection_scope: single-model fixed partition/SP scaling (Wan2.1, Wan2.2, SD3.5)
xdit.role: external native engine validation under fixed partition / static SP (unoptimized single-GPU per request, xdit-sp1)

partition_image_gpus.rule: mean measured GPU work weighted by resolution distribution class counts

benchmark.scope: 5-phase 500-request non-stationary mixed-modality sustained SLA and HBM/SHM stability soak

absolute_rate.basis: mean offered arrival rate over the frozen finite-trace duration

same_parallelism_segmentation_gate.scope: continuous vs. sub-step block-segmented execution under identical parallel form and group

cross_sp_acceptance_gate.scope: cross-SP / elastic degree transitions (SP1 vs. CFG2 vs. CFG2xSP2/3/4) where non-associative BF16 All-to-All reduction order differs
cross_sp_acceptance_gate.numerical_drift_bound: bounded BF16 collective reduction drift with semantic quality equivalence (PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/VBench) instead of 1e-5 elementwise equality

rule.drain_basis: sum of per-request calibrated SP1 service; conservative planning estimate, not a measured upper bound

time_planning.scope: calibration-based execution budget; not measured performance or guaranteed completion
